definitions.cohorts: Annotation counts with separate headline/group counts; overlapping cohorts and repeated seeds are not independent observations. Seen/unseen means exact native string.
definitions.conditioning: Per matched seed: fixed = headline wrong, pair correct; harmed = headline correct, pair wrong. Persistent requires all three seeds in each direction.
definitions.manual_review: Purposive qualitative sample; overlapping tags; suspected ambiguity is reviewer judgment, not relabeling or independent adjudication.
definitions.persistence: Wrong in k/3 separately trained target-pair seeds; predictions may differ even when all seeds are wrong.

qualitative_review.protocol: Up to five annotation examples per declared stratum, distinct headline duplicate groups within a stratum; SHA-256(target-review-v1:42:example_id) order. Deduplicate example IDs across strata, preserving all selection reasons. All nine wrong = all three target-pair seeds of all three models wrong. Persistent fix/harm requires all three headline seeds wrong/correct and all three paired seeds correct/wrong within at least one model. Comparison regex and nonliteral matching select review candidates only, not automatic error tags. Selected annotation examples may share headlines across strata. Purposive, not representative; no error-category prevalence estimate. No ensemble model.
qualitative_review.reviewer: Codex exploratory qualitative review; not independent human adjudication

verification: All 18 original private reports/prediction hashes, native ordered validation rows/gold, 108 cohort metric sets, artifact manifests and matched seed initialization/order. Metric tolerance is 1e-12; prediction bytes match exactly. Full weight bytes are not loaded in this analysis; prior Windows training verified them.
